categories.label: Entities
categories.description: All 157 entity types in the 26.2 registry, compared with the goal sets vanilla registers for each one.

entries.name: Blaze
entries.note: Shoots fireballs but has normal gravity and ground navigation, so it cannot hover.

entries.name: Bogged
entries.note: Wraps the skeleton base, so it shoots a bow like vanilla.

items.text: Skeleton goal set with bow attack

entries.name: Breeze
entries.note: Wanders and targets players but never attacks; the wind charge projectile exists, nothing fires it.

entries.name: Cave Spider
entries.note: Same gaps as the spider.

items.text: Poison on hit, scaled by difficulty
Freezes while a player looks at it

entries.name: Creeper
entries.note: Ignites and explodes like vanilla. Only the cat and ocelot avoidance and the effect cloud are missing.

items.text: Area effect cloud from potion effects

entries.name: Drowned
entries.note: Spawn rules exist, but the entity registers none of its own goals, so trident drowned never throw.

issues.title: Trident Drowned Only Attack in Melee Range
Drowned Zombie burn in water when jumping

entries.name: Elder Guardian
entries.note: Mining fatigue and spikes work; the beam attack does not exist.

entries.name: Enderman
entries.note: Teleports, moves blocks and gets angry when stared at, but hovers in mid-air and never freezes in place.

items.text: Teleports away from projectiles and towards targets

issues.title: Enderman floating and walking in mid-air

items.text: Fangs, vex summon and wololo spells

entries.name: Giant
entries.note: Vanilla giant registers no goals at all. Pumpkin adds a small goal set on top.

entries.name: Guardian
entries.note: Swims with the generic set and hurts attackers. The beam attack, the whole identity of the mob, does not exist.

entries.name: Husk
entries.note: Wraps the zombie base with desert spawn rules.

entries.name: Illusioner
entries.note: No spells and no bow.

entries.name: Magma Cube
entries.note: Built on the slime entity, so it inherits the full slime goal set.

items.text: Slime goal set: attack, jump, split

entries.name: Parched
entries.note: New in 26.2, wraps the skeleton base.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.note: Look goals only. It has no target selector and does nothing.

entries.name: Piglin
entries.note: Bartering, admiring and zombification all work on a hand-rolled activity system. The vanilla brain port replaces that system rather than adding features.

items.text: Bartering with gold and barter loot
Celebrating and dancing after a hunt
Crossbow and melee attack, repellent avoidance

issues.title: Mobs do not aggro on player, and only sometimes do when attacked with weapon

entries.name: Ravager
entries.note: Goal set matches vanilla.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.note: Bow and melee goals are registered at the same time, so skeletons walk up and hit you with the bow.

items.text: Swap bow and melee on held-item change

entries.name: Slime
entries.note: Goal set matches vanilla. Landing particles are still pending.

items.text: Slime chunk and swamp spawn rules

entries.name: Spider
entries.note: Uses the generic melee set. No leap, no wall climbing, no daylight gate on targeting.

entries.name: Stray
entries.note: Wraps the skeleton base with powder snow spawn checks.

items.text: Sky and powder snow spawn rules

entries.name: Sulfur Cube
entries.note: New in 26.2. Spawn rules exist but there is no entity type or goals.

issues.title: Sulfur Cube mobs do not have AI

entries.name: Warden
entries.note: Placeholder goals only. Sniffing, the sonic boom and anger are all brain driven in vanilla.

entries.name: Witch
entries.note: Throws and drinks potions and joins raids, but never heals other raiders.

items.text: Drinks potions to heal and resist

entries.name: Wither Skeleton
entries.note: Wraps the skeleton base, which registers a bow goal the wither skeleton should not have.

items.text: Melee-only weapon handling, inherits the bow goal

entries.name: Zombie
entries.note: Base zombie goals match vanilla, including door breaking and turtle egg raids.

entries.name: Zombie Villager
entries.note: Villager profession data and curing are ported.

items.text: Zombie goal set and nether spawn rules

entries.name: Ender Dragon
entries.note: All twelve flight phases are ported. Collision and damage still run against the main bounding box instead of the parts.

items.text: Part tracking, not yet registered as world entities

entries.name: Wither
entries.note: Shoots skulls from all three heads and breaks blocks, but does not fly and only targets whatever hurt it.

items.text: Spawning from soul sand and skulls
Wither skulls from all three heads

entries.name: Bee
entries.note: Registers the generic animal set only, so bees never enter hives, pollinate or grow crops.

items.text: Nectar, sting and hive timer state

entries.name: Camel Husk
entries.note: New in 26.2. Spawn rules exist but there is no entity type.

entries.name: Cat
entries.note: Taming, following and avoidance work. Sitting, beds and pouncing are state flags without goals behind them.

items.text: `SitWhenOrderedToGoal`, sit pose is synced but not enforced

entries.name: Cod
entries.note: Bobs in place on the ground navigator.

entries.name: Fox
entries.note: State flags are synced, but every fox-specific goal is missing.

items.text: Tongue attack on slimes and magma cubes

entries.name: Happy Ghast
entries.note: Tempts, leashes and holds still, approximated with goals.

entries.name: Iron Golem
entries.note: Attacks monsters and offers flowers. Player targeting is left out until an anger memory exists, so village and reputation behaviour is missing.

items.text: Player targeting from anger and reputation

issues.title: Iron golems unconditionally target and attack nearby players

entries.name: Nautilus
entries.note: New in 26.2. Taming, riding and dash state exist, but no goals are registered.

entries.name: Panda
entries.note: Genes and pose flags are synced, but every panda-specific goal is missing.

items.text: Sit, lie on back, sneeze and roll

entries.name: Parrot
entries.note: Walks everywhere because there is no flying navigation, and all tamed behaviour is missing.

items.text: Saddle and carrot on a stick

entries.name: Pufferfish
entries.note: Bobs in place on the ground navigator.

entries.name: Salmon
entries.note: Bobs in place on the ground navigator.

entries.name: Tropical Fish
entries.note: Bobs in place on the ground navigator.

entries.name: Turtle
entries.note: Never lays eggs, goes home or travels.

items.text: Beach spawn rules and egg state flags

entries.name: Wolf
entries.note: Player targeting is left out on purpose until an anger memory exists, so wolves never get angry eyes.

items.text: Prey targets for sheep, rabbit, fox and skeleton
`SitWhenOrderedToGoal`, sit pose is synced but not enforced
Remaining prey: baby turtle, stray, bogged, parched, bat

issues.title: Wolfs attack you even if you do not hit them and also doesnt use red eyes

entries.name: Zombie Nautilus
entries.note: New in 26.2. Not implemented.

entries.name: Mannequin
entries.note: New in 26.x. Not implemented.

entries.name: Villager
entries.note: Approximated with goals. Trading, work sites and hostile avoidance work; everything activity and reputation driven is missing.

items.text: Gossip and reputation with trade discounts

entries.name: Wandering Trader
entries.note: Trades, wanders and drinks its potions. Natural spawning and the llama escort are missing.

issues.title: [Feature] Implement vanilla Wandering Trader spawning and lifecycle
Wandering Trader Spawns with All Trades Locked

entries.name: Dragon Fireball
entries.note: Not implemented.

entries.name: Experience Bottle
entries.note: Using the item spawns the orbs at the player instead of throwing a bottle.

entries.name: Spectral Arrow
entries.note: Shares the arrow entity.

items.text: Loyalty and riptide through the item
